ria: Quick RFC follow-up after the noisy canary this morning. We need a compact intake replayability plan + a cheap fast-admit sanity check so benches don't spin on tokenization edge-cases. Not proposing heavy benches, just deterministic cheap guards.

sam: +1. My take: two orthogonal pieces: 1) deterministic fast-admit (inline, <30ms) that checks tokenizer fingerprint + minimal shape metadata; 2) a reproducible replay artifact for any intake that hits WARN/FAIL so we can rerun full benches later.

tess: agree. For fast-admit, suggest outcomes: ACCEPT, SHADOW, HOLD. HOLD = block auto-promotion and attach a tiny replay bundle (<=256 bytes) with 8 short examples + token mappings. SHADOW = proceed but don't promote automatically.

leo: implementation notes: tokenizer fingerprint = sha1(serialized_tokenizer_spec) truncated to 64 bits. shape metadata = {vocab_size, embedding_dim, kv_format_tag}. fast-admit rule example:

```
if tok_hash != catalog.tok_hash: return HOLD
if abs(vocab_size - catalog.vocab_size)>32: return SHADOW
return ACCEPT
```

ria: operational tradeoff: how strict by default? We should default to enforce for hosted/dedicated and shadow for labs. Add descriptor field: "admit_mode": "enforce|shadow|off".

sam: replay artifact design: content-addressed small bundle stored in CAS. Fields: manifest_ref, small_sample_list, tokenizer_hash, converter_version. This lets us reconstruct exact benches later. Keep bundle <=256B base64.

tess: for sampling, pick stratified samples: 2 short, 2 medium, 2 long, 2 engineered rare-token probes. Deterministic selection by model family and manifest seed. That avoids flaky random picks.

leo: telemetry: emit event fast_admit.v1 with model_ref, result, delta_vocab, replay_ref (if HOLD), latency_ms. Also track FP/FN by comparing to later golden evals. We'll need a replay job that replays HOLDs through the full pipeline daily.

ria: rollout: 1) implement fast-admit lambda in shadow for 7 days at 5% intake; 2) enable replay job and collect FP/FN; 3) adjust thresholds; 4) flip defaults. Add a short retro doc before flip.

sam: edge-case: if catalog missing token hash (old entries), treat as SHADOW not HOLD. Also add allow-once token in UI for rapid unblock, logs reason.

tess: I'll proto the sample selector and small bundle serializer. Add unit tests for determinism across SDK versions.

leo: I'll own telemetry schema + replay job. Also add dashboard panels for replay-hit-rate and allow-once usage.

ria: I'll own rollout doc and retro checklist. Tagging @onboard-bot to create the shadow-run ticket and schedule.

onboard-bot: Created ticket https://redwood.internal/boards/ONBOARD-5033 and scheduled shadow-run window 4932200000-4933020000.

ria: action list: tess -> sample selector + bundle proto, sam -> fast-admit lambda prototype, leo -> telemetry + replay job, ria -> rollout doc. Sync in 45.
